command:
set -eu
root=/srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
build="$root/.recovered.build.$$"
mkdir "$build"
cleanup() { rm -rf "$build"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
while IFS= read -r archive || [ -n "$archive" ]; do
  [ -n "$archive" ] || continue
  case "$archive" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.. ) printf 'unsafe chain entry: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  [ -f "$root/$archive" ] || { printf 'missing archive: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1; }
  if tar -tf "$root/$archive" | grep -Eq '(^/)|(^|/)\.\.(/|$)'; then
    printf 'unsafe member in %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1
  fi
  tar -xf "$root/$archive" -C "$build"
  if [ -f "$build/deletions.txt" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r removed || [ -n "$removed" ]; do
      [ -n "$removed" ] || continue
      case "$removed" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.. ) printf 'unsafe deletion path: %s\n' "$removed" >&2; exit 1;; esac
      rm -rf "$build/$removed"
      printf 'applied %s deletion: %s\n' "$archive" "$removed"
    done < "$build/deletions.txt"
    rm -f "$build/deletions.txt"
  fi
  printf 'applied archive: %s\n' "$archive"
done < "$root/chain.txt"
mv "$build" "$root/recovered"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' 'reconstruction complete'
find "$root/recovered" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 10 -printf '%P\t%y\t%s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null || find "$root/recovered" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 10 -exec ls -ld {} \;
